C3.title: the instrument-registry gate covers every tracked counter
C3.surface: tools/gate-registry-check.py reads every tracked .ufo/waves/round-*/count-*.py path at the measured revision and requires each to occur in SKILL.md. At the freeze tip it reports `unregistered .ufo/waves/round-29/count-c1.py`, `registered 8 unregistered 1`, exit 1. The after-state is one SKILL.md instrument-registry row for the round-29 counter (kind/entry command, exit map, self-test/pins, write scope), derived from the counter's own docstring and a run of this round, so the same gate reads `registered 9 unregistered 0`, exit 0.
C3.predicate: Claim met iff, at the measured commit, `python3 tools/gate-registry-check.py` prints `unregistered 0` and exits 0, and the SKILL.md row for `.ufo/waves/round-29/count-c1.py` carries that file's sha256 re-derived with sha256sum at the tip, and a round-31 receipt of that counter exists under .ufo/waves/round-31/c3/.
C3.before_receipt: .ufo/waves/round-31/c3/gate-before.out (to be written by the L1 at the freeze tip; the freeze command is the same gate)
C3.kill_rule: The gate path, the predicate and the target are frozen at this file's commit. A miss at the measured tip is an honest stop; no post-data narrowing.
C3.do_nothing_control: A control that appends no row leaves the gate reading `unregistered 1`, exit 1 (the pre-data gate run is the control's receipt).
C3.mutation_control: Deleting the new row from a scratch copy of SKILL.md must return the gate to exit 1 with `unregistered .ufo/waves/round-29/count-c1.py`; the row is load-bearing.
known_limits: The gate checks occurrence of the path, not the accuracy of the row's columns; a wrong exit map in a registered row still passes.
One row, one counter: the claim measures registry coverage of tracked counters, not instrument quality.
